question: What equivalence is established between the eye-line end and the fold end?
premises: The end of the eye-line measures two parts
The end of the fold is equal to that
inference: The distance to the eye-line end and to the fold end are both two parts and equal
uncertainties: The precise anatomical referents of netrasūtra and puṭa are uncertain
plain_english: The end of the eye-line is two parts, and the end of the fold is equal to that.
